name: MBB Bo 105
summary: A compact twin-turbine helicopter famous as the first light twin with a rigid rotor; widely used for EMS and police work.

wings: Four-blade rigid hingeless rotor with short, wide-chord blades
engines: Twin turboshafts side by side on the roof behind the head
Two exhaust stubs at the rear top
fuselage: Boxy compact pod with large clamshell rear doors
Skids on tall struts; big windscreen
tail: Straight tail boom with horizontal stabilizer carrying large end plates
Two-blade tail rotor on the side

tellTales: Short stubby mast with a four-blade rotor with broad blades
Boxy pod with twin exhausts and rear clamshell doors
Horizontal stabilizer with big endplate fins

confusedWith.howToTell: The BK 117 is larger and longer with a taller, more upswept tail; the Bo 105 is a smaller, stubbier box with a shorter fuselage.
The H145 is much bigger with sliding doors and a longer cabin; the Bo 105 is a short boxy pod with rear clamshell doors.
The 429 has smooth modern curves and larger windows; the Bo 105 is more boxy with a very short mast.
